subject: Aids to Navigation - Tulita mile 512 to Fort Good Hope mile 684
text:
Aids to Navigation - Tulita mile 512 to Fort Good Hope mile 684
Due to the prevailing low water levels on the Mackenzie River, the Canadian Coast Guard will not be lifting any buoys between mile 666.7 and mile 684. Buoys will not be monitored for the remainder of the navigation season and may be off their advertised position.  Mariners should not rely on any aids to navigation in that section of the Mackenzie River.
